title: Giza Plateau - The Great Pyramids
lore: Late afternoon on the Giza plateau: the three great pyramids rise over a sea of dunes, the Sphinx guards the causeway, and the Nile valley glows green on the eastern horizon.
notes: Real dimensions: Khufu 230.3 m base / 138.5 m, Khafre 215.3/136.4, Menkaure 104.6/65.5
